# zeroword_project (Resource)

A Project groups Environments inside a Workspace. Deleting a Project fails while it still has Environments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zeroword_project" "app" {
  workspace_id = data.zeroword_workspace.this.id
  name         = "app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name (1-200 characters).
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID (`wsp_...`). Must be the API key's Workspace.

### Optional

- `slug` (String) URL slug. Generated from the name when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Project ID (`prj_...`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import zeroword_project.app prj_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```
